lines.en: Mia, look at this photo. The first computer was huge!
lines.pt: Mia, olhe esta foto. O primeiro computador era enorme!

lines.en: Wow. It was bigger than our whole office, wasn’t it?
lines.pt: Uau. Era maior que o nosso escritório inteiro, não era?

lines.en: Almost. It was very heavy, heavier than a car, and it was louder than a train.
lines.pt: Quase. Era muito pesado, mais que um carro, e mais barulhento que um trem.

lines.en: Was it faster than a person with a calculator?
lines.pt: Era mais rápido que uma pessoa com uma calculadora?

lines.en: Yes, but it was slower than my phone. My phone is much, much faster.
lines.pt: Sim, mas era mais lento que o meu celular. O meu celular é muito, muito mais rápido.

lines.en: And how much was a computer in those days?
lines.pt: E quanto custava um computador naquela época?

lines.en: It was more expensive than a house. Only big companies and schools had one.
lines.pt: Era mais caro que uma casa. Só grandes empresas e escolas tinham um.

lines.en: Were the screens as clear as ours?
lines.pt: As telas eram tão nítidas quanto as nossas?

lines.en: No, they weren’t. They were smaller and darker, and the keyboard was harder to use.
lines.pt: Não. Eram menores e mais escuras, e o teclado era mais difícil de usar.

lines.en: Still, it was a great machine. Without it, our work would be harder.
lines.pt: Mesmo assim, era uma grande máquina. Sem ela, nosso trabalho seria mais difícil.

lines.en: True. Now let’s save our files. The meeting was shorter than I thought.
lines.pt: Verdade. Agora vamos salvar nossos arquivos. A reunião foi mais curta do que eu pensava.

facts.big: It was slower than my phone
facts.label: Passado e comparativo
facts.sub: Use was/were + adjetivo + than: It was slower than my phone. More + adjetivo longo: more expensive than.

facts.label: mais … do que
facts.sub: Use -er com adjetivos curtos: faster than, slower than, bigger than, louder than. Para o passado, use was ou were: It was louder than a train. Em heavy, o y vira i: heavier.

facts.label: mais … do que
facts.sub: Use more com adjetivos longos: more expensive than, more difficult than. Não use -er com adjetivos longos. Exemplo: It was more expensive than a house.

compare.ask: It was slower than my phone.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “mais rápido que” e “mais caro que”.
compare.tip: Diga: “It was slower than my phone.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use adjetivo curto + er + than: faster than, bigger than, slower than. Com adjetivo longo, use more + adjetivo + than: more expensive than. Para o passado, use was ou were: It was heavier than a car.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We say “It was slower than my phone.”
We say “It was more bigger than a car.”
items.why: We say bigger than, without more.

items.s: With long adjectives we use more: more expensive than.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We say “It was slower than my phone.” → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “It was more bigger than a car.” → Falso (We say bigger than, without more.)
With long adjectives we use more: more expensive than. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: An office in Denver · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold morning in Denver. Anya and Tom work in a small office. A photo hangs on the wall. It shows a very old machine. Tom drinks his hot coffee. Anya wants to talk about it.

“Tom, look at this photo. The first computer was huge!” says Anya. “Wow. It was bigger than our whole office, wasn’t it?” says Tom. “Almost. It was very heavy, heavier than a car, and it was louder than a train.” says Anya.
